conclusion: The right and left meshes already serialize identical raw UV coordinates at corresponding mirrored polygon corners, while only the right-side SI_Texture2D blocks retain the pi-Y matrix. Therefore the SI_Texture2D matrix is additional live texture/projection state and is not merely an alternate encoding of the serialized SI_MeshTextureCoords.
interpretive_boundary: The pi-Y matrix is self-inverse, so this pair cannot distinguish direct from inverse application.

The right-side pi-Y operation is consistent with a live U/UVW mirror that can compensate the visual reflection of mirrored geometry, but that rendering interpretation remains a hypothesis until an asymmetric transform is independently validated.
Official Softimage documentation independently states that projection UVW transformations remain live until Freeze bakes them into UV coordinates.
